## Requirements: standalone Nession Pages MVP

**Parent:** #1782. Deliver Phase 1 only, without claiming that Phase 2 full Issue→PR→Agent exact-SHA drilldown or Phase 3 independent orphan integrity audit is complete.

### Scope / boundaries
Build a public project home and read-only AI engineering observatory, completely isolated under root `pages/`. It must have its **own typography, themes, design tokens, components, CSS, navigation and build**, never import or copy the authenticated product `web/`. The public artifact is generated from a pinned read-only `metrics` checkout, sanitized AI Role Registry and GitHub API snapshots. Unknown observations are N/A, never guessed. A public orphan ref does not imply trusted integrity.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 A dependency-independent root `pages/` project builds an accessible static public site, with its own design system and no `web/` imports or copied UI assets.
- [ ] SC-02 Home explains Nession and the AI collaboration workflow, with independent mobile navigation and direct hash-based deep links.
- [ ] SC-03 Agents shows role registry plus observed 7d runs/tokens/tool calls/cost coverage without equating workflow Agents to runtime node Agents or inventing per-Agent token costs.
- [ ] SC-04 Repository and Collaboration render sanitized public snapshot metrics and open GitHub Issues/PRs with clear main SHA/generation metadata and truthful absent data.
- [ ] SC-05 Evidence view only exposes branch-presence metadata; no raw Run Store data, private sessions, host identifiers or false append-only claims.
- [ ] SC-06 Build-time projection has strict read-only, versioned, bounded allowlists and deterministic positive/negative fixtures; Pages and product Web builds stay independent.
- [ ] SC-07 Real Playwright assertions exercise standalone public Home/Agents/Work/Repository/Evidence navigation, safe untrusted text, responsive/deep link behavior and source/absence states at exact PR SHA.
